headline: Marubeni H1 Profit Jumps 45% on Commodities and Trading, Hikes Guidance
summary: Marubeni reported a 45% increase in first-half profit driven by commodities and trading operations, leading the company to raise its annual earnings guidance.
why: Marubeni Corp. is a major Japanese sogo shosha (general trading company) with extensive global exposure to energy, metals, chemicals, and grain markets, serving as a key barometer for international trade and commodity demand.

impacts.name: Marubeni
impacts.why: Stronger H1 profit and an upward revision in annual guidance directly benefit the company's equity valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A 45% profit jump and raised full-year guidance signal robust operational momentum and cash generation in trading and commodities, prompting a positive re-pricing by investors.
